existing_capabilities.page_review_selection_policy: recover registered source-text anchors first, then prefer layout or table-preserving output, then longer normalized text and stable backend name
source_integrity_checks: declared section and exact source text are present before import verification

architecture_candidates.name: Verified PDF Page Candidate Ledger
architecture_candidates.reason: Creates a durable candidate-only layer with page and span provenance, reuses verified PDF extraction, and prevents candidate text from becoming an approved import without a separate review decision.

architecture_candidates.name: Gap-scoped Candidate Probe
architecture_candidates.reason: Efficient for known gaps but hard-codes the current review queue and cannot become a reusable receipt-level extraction foundation.

architecture_candidates.name: Raw Page Text Archive
architecture_candidates.reason: Preserves text safely but provides no stable candidate identity, span contract or review queue.

architecture_candidates.name: Direct Import-spec Synthesis
architecture_candidates.reason: Conflates extraction with semantic approval and would create configuration, attribute or context projections that the source may not support.

architecture_candidates.name: OCR-first Multimodal Pipeline
architecture_candidates.reason: Could help image-only pages later but introduces a new nondeterministic dependency and is unnecessary for the first text-backed foundation.

selection.name: Verified PDF Page Candidate Ledger
selection.rationale: The repository already verifies source hashes, extracts individual pages through deterministic text backends and requires exact source text before approved imports. The missing layer is a canonical candidate ledger that preserves source, page, backend and text-span identity while remaining semantically unapproved.

extraction_contract.page_scope: every declared page of every registered source

determinism_requirements: byte-identical repeated output with the same source files and backend version
stable source, page and candidate ordering
no timestamps or environment-specific absolute paths

promotion_boundary.required_next_step: a separately authored review decision cites candidate_id and exact source text

required_tests: source receipt ordering and integrity verification
empty text produces a visual-review or extraction boundary rather than not_stated
byte-identical repeated JSON and Markdown output
no files under data/imports are created
CLI fails closed on bytes, SHA-256 or page-count drift

next_package.name: Verified PDF Candidate Ledger Foundation
next_package.goal: Implement the receipt-driven pdf-candidate-ledger command and deterministic JSON and Markdown candidate artifacts for the five registered official brochures, preserving source, page, backend and span provenance while creating no master-data rows or approved import specifications.
